basic_info.description: Welcome to 16 Winfield Street. This clean, bright, and airy mid-century home offers expansive western views and stunning afternoon light from the main living area and eat-in kitchen. Gleaming hardwood floors, new appliances, and updated electrical and plumbing add modern comfort, while the spacious garage includes laundry for convenience.  Two cozy bedrooms capture the morning sun, and a third bedroom  on the lower level features a view to the west. A large deck is perfect for indoor-outdoor living. Sloped backyard with mature plantings awaits your landscaping vision.  Very well maintained and updated, this home is located in sought-after Northwest Bernal Heights, convenient to parks, shopping, amenities, and transportation.
